# Standards and Learning References

Use these as anchors rather than copying checklists blindly.

- OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS): broad application security verification requirements.
- OWASP API Security Top 10: API-specific risks such as broken object authorization, broken authentication, resource consumption, sensitive business flows, SSRF, misconfiguration, and unsafe API consumption.
- OWASP Cheat Sheet Series: focused implementation guidance.
- Provider/framework security docs for the actual technologies in the project.
- Gitleaks, CodeQL, Semgrep, OSV-Scanner, Trivy, and OWASP ZAP documentation for scanner operation and limitations.

For every mapping, cite the requirement/category only when the finding genuinely matches it. Do not turn standards mapping into a claim of certification.
